DECISION AND ORDER OF THE ILLINOIS LABOR RELATIONS BOARD
STATE PANEL
On July 14, 2025, Administrative Law Judge (“ALJ”) Anna Hamburg-Gal issued a
Recommended Decision and Order (“RDO”) recommending dismissal of the unit clarification
petition filed by Petitioner State of Illinois, Department of Central Management Services, seeking to
exclude a newly created and vacant Administrative Assistant II position within the Department of
Innovation and Technology from an existing bargaining unit represented by the American Federation
of State, County, and Municipal Employees, Council 31 (“Union”). Petitioner filed exceptions to the
RDO, and the parties presented oral arguments on October 23, 2025.
On November 4, 2025, the Illinois AFL-CIO filed a Motion for Leave to File a Brief Amicus
Curiae (“Amicus Brief”) along with a copy of the brief in support of the Union’s position that it seeks
to file. For the same reasons we set the matter for oral argument, we find that additional briefing will
be beneficial to our consideration and resolution of the issues presented. We further find that
accepting the Amicus Brief will not serve to delay or postpone the proceedings.
For the above reasons, we grant the Motion for Leave to File a Brief Amicus Curiae and
accept the Amicus Brief pursuant to Section 1200.140(c) of the Board’s Rules and Regulations, 80
Ill. Adm. Code § 1200.140(c).
BY THE STATE PANEL OF THE ILLINOIS LABOR RELATIONS BOARD
